title: Promise of new SAR scans of Khafre to detect the Belzoni chamber

tellings.quote: I ensure you that more scans will be done on the Khafre in order to find something to detect Belzoni.

plain: More radar scans of the pyramid of Khafre, one of the great pyramids at Giza in Egypt, are promised for 2026, with the aim of finding a hidden space called the Belzoni chamber. The promise comes from a radar researcher named Filippo Biondi, whose team uses satellite radar imaging (known as SAR) to look beneath the ground. "I ensure you that more scans will be done on the Khafre in order to find something to detect Belzoni," he tells Michels, a sign he expects the chamber to show up.
